authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL hastatala palm gives Pali hatthatala, Punjabi/Hindi hathelī, Kumaoni hat(h)elī and Gujarati hathelī, alongside Sinhala atala. The selected hath-/het(h)-lateral and hattala/attal palm forms match this documented compound family, retaining vowel, aspiration and lateral/retroflex notation. The article explicitly reports Hindi to Gujarati transmission; local IA transmission for these surveys remains unresolved. Exact response: attal.
